components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single call to action: Shop Now, Add to Cart, Checkout.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #BC5254; color: #fff; padding: 12px 32px; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease, transform .2s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #A24E50; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #A24E50; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ghost action such as View cart; white fill with mocha hairline.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #fff; color: #8B6F5C; padding: 8px 16px; border: 1px solid rgba(139,111,92,.2); border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 600; font-size: .875rem; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color .15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #FDF6F1; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8B6F5C; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: Catalog product tile: square image, serif title, coral-adjacent price.
components.html:
Meadow Bloom Mug

components.css: .ds-card-product { display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(245,213,200,.3); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); overflow: hidden; text-decoration: none; transition: box-shadow .3s ease, transform .3s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-card-product:hover { box-shadow: 0 18px 40px -24px rgba(95,81,73,0.35); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-card-product__media { aspect-ratio: 1/1; background: #F8F9FA; } .ds-card-product__body { padding: 16px; } .ds-card-product__title { font-family: ui-serif, Georgia, serif; color: #8B6F5C; font-size: 1.125rem; margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-product__desc { color: #A08577; font-size: .8125rem; margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-card-product__price { color: #8B6F5C; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.25rem; margin: 0; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Primary navigation link: spaced uppercase Avenir in mocha.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { font-family: 'Avenir Next', Avenir, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .08em; font-weight: 600; font-size: .95rem; color: #8B6F5C; text-decoration: none; transition: color .15s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #6B5F4C; } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #8B6F5C; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Testimonial Card
components.description: Frosted quote card with soft-pink stars and initials avatar.
components.css: .ds-testimonial { margin: 0; padding: 24px; background: rgba(255,255,255,.6); backdrop-filter: blur(4px); border: 1px solid rgba(245,213,200,.3); border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05); text-align: center; } .ds-testimonial__stars { display: flex; justify-content: center; gap: 2px; margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-testimonial__quote { color: #A08577; line-height: 1.6; margin: 0 0 16px; } .ds-testimonial__by { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; } .ds-testimonial__avatar { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 9999px; background: rgba(248,200,220,.2); color: #8B6F5C; font-weight: 600; font-size: .875rem; } .ds-testimonial__name { color: #8B6F5C; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.overview: Blossom Bloom is a small maker's studio rendered on screen: taupe-and-rose ink laid over soft, bloom-tinted rooms, everything touched by diffuse light and finished by hand. The mood is calm, elegant, and heartfelt, the feeling of choosing a gift you know will be treasured. Warmth is carried by color, typography, and generous air, never by volume. The system rests on a signature per-page pastel background paired with a constant warm-neutral ink and a single rose-coral action color, so the store reads as connected, sunlit rooms rather than different websites.
keyCharacteristics: Warm taupe-and-rose neutrals over soft pastel, bloom-tinted page backgrounds.
A single rose-coral accent reserved for actions and prices.
Serif for editorial calm; spaced uppercase sans for navigation.
Soft, diffuse, brown-tinted shadows; lifted but never hard.
Boutique curation over uniform catalog grids.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Rose Coral (#BC5254) means act. It is for primary buttons, prices, and their hovers, nothing else. Its rarity is the point.

rules.name: The Room-Per-Page Rule
rules.body: Each template owns one pastel background; the mocha ink and coral accent never rotate, so pages feel like connected rooms.

rules.name: The Serif-Heads Rule
rules.body: All headings are serif; navigation and micro-labels are the spaced uppercase Avenir sans. Never swap them.

rules.name: The Warm-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Shadows are tinted with the brand brown, never pure gray-black, and always large-blur and low-opacity. A tight dark gray shadow is prohibited.

dos: Do reserve Rose Coral (#BC5254) for actions and prices only.
Do keep the per-page pastel background system and hold the mocha ink + coral accent constant.
Do set headings in the serif and navigation/labels in the spaced uppercase Avenir sans.
Do use large-blur, low-opacity, brown-tinted shadows for a soft, lifted feel.
Do verify body text contrast (Clay Taupe #A08577, Cocoa Ink #5F5149) clears 4.5:1; darken toward mocha if borderline.
Do add a visible :focus-visible state to every button and link.
donts: Don't be bargain- or discount-driven: no clearance banners, countdown timers, or cluttered promos.
Don't look corporate or mass-produced, like a generic print-on-demand supplier.
Don't drift cold or tech-minimal: no sterile all-gray SaaS surfaces.
Don't ship the anonymous default Shopify template look.
Don't use tight, dark, gray-black shadows.
Don't tint headings, borders, or backgrounds with the coral accent.
